sources.title: Liam Coen: We're gonna look at giving Travis Hunter some more this week
sources.description: Travis Hunter's snap counts on both sides of the ball have been closely scrutinized since the Jaguars traded up to take him with the second overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft and Week 2 was no exception on that front.
